findings.title: Target Service Operates Over Unencrypted HTTP
findings.description: The application endpoint serves traffic over unencrypted plaintext HTTP, exposing sensitive communications to eavesdropping and MITM attacks.
findings.evidence: Target URL 'http://demo.owasp-juice.shop?utm_source=chatgpt.com' uses plaintext http scheme.
findings.remediation: Configure a TLS certificate and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS (Port 443).

findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP) Header
findings.description: A Content Security Policy restricts sources of executable scripts, stylesheets, and frames, preventing Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
findings.evidence: Header 'Content-Security-Policy' was absent in response to http://demo.owasp-juice.shop?utm_source=chatgpt.com
findings.remediation: Implement a strong `Content-Security-Policy` header (e.g. `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'`).

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: The Referrer-Policy header controls how much referrer information (sent via the Referer header) should be included with requests.
